facts.fact: A technical adviser to Chad's planning minister, presenting at the 2024 Africa Regional Forum on Sustainable Development, lists Loi 26/PR/2019 of 11 June 2019 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities in Chad among the reforms strengthening the national statistical system.
facts.system: Loi 26/PR/2019 portant organisation et reglementation des activites statistiques (2019)

systems.system: Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique (SNDS 2021-2025), adopted by Décret N°0573/PCMT/PMT/MEPDCI/2021 of 14 October 2021
